cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: So we learned that as a data engineer, you collect data, you ingest data, and then you store it in
cues.zh: 前面知道，資料工程師會收集、擷取資料，再存入，

cues.en: a data lake, often a Hadoop cluster.
cues.zh: 資料湖，常見的是 Hadoop 叢集。

cues.en: Now, this idea of a data lake can also be used with something like a S3 object storage.
cues.zh: 也可以使用 S3 物件儲存這類工具建立資料湖。

cues.en: So those are the two most popular ones.
cues.zh: 講者把這兩種列為當時最常見的選項。

cues.en: And then once they're in your data lake, you can usually run batch jobs on this data to clean it up or modify it or wrangle it in some way.
cues.zh: 資料進入資料湖後，通常能執行批次工作，清理、修改，或以某種方式整理。

cues.en: So Hadoop allowed us to do that.
cues.zh: Hadoop 可以做到。

cues.en: With MapReduce, we can use Apache Spark.
cues.zh: 使用 MapReduce，也能使用 Apache Spark。

cues.en: You can just manually write scripts on Amazon S3 or you can just even do best jobs with common databases like SQL databases.
cues.zh: 可以自己寫腳本處理 Amazon S3 的資料，也能用 SQL 等一般資料庫執行批次工作。

cues.en: But this idea of stream processing is now becoming more and more popular.
cues.zh: 但串流處理越來越受歡迎。

cues.en: Instead of processing data using just batch jobs, let's say every hour or every day, there's now a movement towards this idea of real time stream processing.
cues.zh: 不只是每小時、每天做一次批次處理，而是逐漸走向即時串流處理。

cues.en: That means when data is received, processing it right away instead of waiting a bit until we can do batches at a time.
cues.zh: 收到資料就立刻處理，不必等待累積成批。

cues.en: This allows us to have faster reactions to data.
cues.zh: 這讓我們更快對資料做出反應。

cues.en: Now, this idea of stream processing is pretty complicated, but one of the main tools that's being used right now for stream processing is something called Kafka.
cues.zh: 串流處理相當複雜，但錄製時，主要工具之一叫 Kafka。

cues.en: Kafka.
cues.zh: Kafka。

cues.en: If we look on their website is a distributed streaming platform.
cues.zh: 看它的網站，是分散式串流平台。

cues.en: It allows us to read and write streams of data like messaging system.
cues.zh: 像訊息系統一樣，能讀寫資料串流。

cues.en: It allows us to process and it allows us to store data as well.
cues.zh: 也能處理、儲存資料。

cues.en: But as you can see what Kafka does, it allows us to receive messages and pass it on to different places.
cues.zh: Kafka 可以接收訊息，再送往不同地方。

cues.en: So what you'll often see is we use Apache Kafka to receive all these messages, logs and data from all
cues.zh: 所以經常會看到，用 Apache Kafka 接收所有來源的訊息、紀錄與資料，

cues.en: these sources.
cues.zh: 也就是這些來源。

cues.en: We collect them in a central location and then Kafka can pass it on to different locations.
cues.zh: 先集中，再由 Kafka 傳送到不同位置。

cues.en: For example, we can pass off whatever Kafka receives to a Hadoop cluster to store that data.
cues.zh: 例如把 Kafka 收到的資料送往 Hadoop 叢集儲存。

cues.en: And then perhaps, if we want, use Apache Spark to process that data into a data warehouse.
cues.zh: 需要的話，再用 Apache Spark 處理，放進資料倉儲。

cues.en: But now, with the idea of real time processing, Kafka allows us to now pass things on to well itself.
cues.zh: 不過有了即時處理，Kafka 也能把資料送給自身的處理功能。

cues.en: Or we can use something like Spark Streaming or Flink, which we've talked about Apache Flink that is
cues.zh: 或使用 Spark Streaming，以及前面談過、比較著重串流處理的，

cues.en: used more for stream processing or Apache Storm or even Kinesis by Amazon, which actually can also
cues.zh: Apache Flink，還有 Apache Storm，甚至 Amazon Kinesis；它也能，

cues.en: be placed like Kafka here to handle all these messages from all these locations.
cues.zh: 放在 Kafka 這個位置，處理來自各處的訊息。

cues.en: Now, at the end of the day, all of this might have been confusing.
cues.zh: 最後，這些內容可能讓你覺得困惑。

cues.en: You may be overwhelmed by all of these tools that are available.
cues.zh: 工具太多，可能有點不知所措。

cues.en: But remember what I said at the beginning of this section.
cues.zh: 但記得這一節最開始說的。

cues.en: A data engineer is somebody that you'll interact with as a data scientist.
cues.zh: 資料科學家會和資料工程師合作。

cues.en: So it's good to know what they do, what their roles are, what their responsibilities are, and you'll
cues.zh: 所以知道他們做什麼、角色與責任是什麼，很有幫助。你會，

cues.en: work closely with them for you to have the data available to perform analysis on it or build machine learning models.
cues.zh: 和他們密切合作，取得資料，才能分析或建立機器學習模型。

cues.en: But I hope that this diagram now makes sense.
cues.zh: 希望現在這張圖已經清楚。

cues.en: A data engineer creates this landscape for you where they ingest data through Kafka store information using something like Hadoop or Amazon S3.
cues.zh: 資料工程師建立整體環境，透過 Kafka 擷取資料，用 Hadoop、Amazon S3 等儲存。

cues.en: They process that data using something like Apache Spark or Kinesis.
cues.zh: 再用 Apache Spark、Kinesis 等工具處理。

cues.en: And then the even stored data in data warehouses.
cues.zh: 也把資料放進資料倉儲。

cues.en: So tools like Redshift or BigQuery can be used by people inside the business to learn something useful from the data.
cues.zh: 讓企業內部人員能透過 Redshift、BigQuery，從資料學到有用資訊。

cues.en: They build the structure for you to flourish.
cues.zh: 他們建立架構，讓你的工作得以順利發展。

cues.en: So be nice to them.
cues.zh: 所以對他們好一點。

cues.en: And if you're ever interested in any of these technologies, they are changing very fast, but they're definitely worth a look and they're not as intimidating to learn as you might think.
cues.zh: 如果對這些技術感興趣，雖然它們變化很快，但值得看看，學起來也不一定像想像中那麼可怕。

cues.en: I'll see you in the next one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。

cues.en: Bye bye.
cues.zh: 再見。
